summary: Independent 61-criterion checklist walk at 100% coverage finds two High defects: missing required tests/test_outputs.py (RC-STRUCT-001) and a Python/Django agent image on debian:bookworm-slim without canonical-base justification (RC-ENV-010). Oracle reward 1 and NOP reward 0 are green; Harbor LLMaJ and official difficulty trials remain deferred and are not treated as task defects.

evidence.observation: Two-paragraph absolute-path on-call handoff; no task slug/canary; defers HA gates/schema to /app/ha/docs/runbook.md.
Digest-pinned debian:bookworm-slim final base with Django via pip; no justification for skipping python:3.13-slim-bookworm.
Contains Dockerfile, test.sh, test_ha.py only; no test_outputs.py required by Edition 3 flat layout and checklist RC-STRUCT-001.
Binary reward write is correct; pytest target is $TEST_DIR directory collection rather than $TEST_DIR/test_outputs.py.
Requires tests/test_outputs.py in flat layout and canonical language base or credible justification; live public checklist URL returned 404 so POLICY_FRESHNESS=UNVERIFIED.
Fetch returned HTTP 404; stored checklist snapshot 2026-08-08-user-supplied used with UNVERIFIED freshness.

findings.why_it_matters: Edition 3 and the reviewer checklist both require tests/test_outputs.py as the canonical verifier entry module; shipping only test_ha.py breaks the required package contract and the preferred test.sh invocation shape.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add tests/test_outputs.py as the collected entrypoint (thin re-export/import of existing cases is fine), COPY it in tests/Dockerfile, and point tests/test.sh pytest at $TEST_DIR/test_outputs.py (prefer --ctrf).
findings.regression_risk: Ensure pytest still collects the full behavioral suite and Oracle/NOP rewards remain 1/0.

findings.why_it_matters: A Django/Python task fits the sanctioned python:3.13-slim-bookworm canonical final base; using General Debian without a concrete task-specific justification is blocked.
findings.minimal_remediation: Switch the agent final FROM to the pinned python:3.13-slim-bookworm digest from TERMINUS_3_AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md, or keep debian only with a credible Dockerfile/README justification that a canonical Python image could not satisfy.
findings.regression_risk: Rebuild agent image; confirm tmux/asciinema and Django pins still present; re-run Oracle/NOP.
